audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Pantheon/Pantheon/Pantheon/Pantheon/Skill/Skill/Pantheon; content win[] and the packet chart both read Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Pantheon/Pantheon/Karma. Every row disagrees.
audit.why: Karma's Q reaches 950 against a 575-range Comet Spear and a 600-range Shield Vault, so levels 1-5 are hers. Grand Starfall at 6 (180/165/150) plus first-item burst hands 6 and first item to Pantheon. At 53.23% over 62 games, with a dive-shaped kit meeting a shield-and-root engine, the grouped late game returns to Karma.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Karma, phases[4..5].side to Pantheon, phases[6].side to Karma, with the level-6 and first-item whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why describe Karma's Mantra rank and Blackfire spike on rows the chart gives to Pantheon.
audit.why: Karma gains no new ultimate at 6; Pantheon gains a 180s leap with 5500 range that swings other lanes.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Grand Starfall's cooldown and Shield Vault's 9-13s stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns holds no digit, and the decisive interaction is missing entirely: Aegis Assault (E) is a channel, so Karma's W tether root — and Mantra-W — cancels it, while it is up it blocks damage from the front, which is where all your poke comes from.
audit.why: Riot's text has Pantheon set his shield and become invulnerable to damage from the front, striking repeatedly; the channel flag means any immobilizing CC ends it. Karma's W is a 12s flat-cooldown root, so this is a repeatable answer, not a one-off.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries W 13/12/11/10/9, E 22/21/20/19/18 and R 180/165/150; the cancel is stated in dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; the front-only block is stated in dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing mentions Mortal Will empowering every few spells or attacks, which is why extended trades get worse the longer they run.
audit.why: It is in Riot's passive text and it is the reason short trades beat long ones here.

edits.before: Pantheon wins by landing Shield Vault (Stun), denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Pantheon wins by landing Shield Vault on a Karma with no dash, then finishing behind an Aegis Assault your poke cannot get through.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Check it before every step-up. - RE shield-speed is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Shield Vault: 13s at rank 1, 9s maxed — a 600-range dash stun with an attack reset; step up only once it is spent. - Aegis Assault is 22s at rank 1 and blocks damage from the front, so never poke into a raised shield. - Grand Starfall is 180/165/150.

edits.before: Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Your 12s tether cancels Aegis Assault outright — root him mid-channel and the invulnerability ends there.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, and on real windows RQ-W: the chunk plus tether-root turns a poke trade into a kill setup — E out before the answer.
edits.after: Shield Vault is a 600-range dash onto you, and the stun lands with it — the shield and its move speed have to be out before he arrives.

edits.before: Pantheon burns Shield Vault (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Aegis Assault only blocks the front — Q him from the side or wait out its 18-22s.

edits.before: That’s Pantheon’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Shield Vault is 600 range — inside that, your tether is his free stun window.

edits.before: Spending Mantra on wave-clear while behind on poke — Karma without RQ banked is a support who took mid's farm.
edits.after: Mortal Will empowers every few casts, so the longer the trade runs the harder each Comet Spear lands.

edits.before: Track Pantheon’s Shield Vault (Stun): Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Shield Vault: a 600-range dash stun on 9-13s, and your W root cancels Aegis Assault mid-channel. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — the RQ chunk cycles every 30 seconds. Chip him below half and hold the kill window.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — the RQ chunk cycles every 30s. Chip him below half and commit once Shield Vault is spent.

edits.before: No new ult — your 6 is a Mantra rank: faster cycles, bigger RQs. Press the early lead before scaling lanes wake up.
edits.after: Grand Starfall lands at 6: a 180s leap that fights other lanes. Your 6 is only a Mantra rank, not a new ultimate.

edits.before: Blackfire/Luden's spike: RQ-W chains threaten kills outright. The lane is now or never — you fall off politely.
edits.after: His first item turns a 9-13s Shield Vault stun into a kill, and Aegis Assault blanks the poke you answer with.

notes: Chart proposed as one atomic group. Rows 0-5 moved the full layer onto the content/packet values, which already agree with each other, so no paired win[N] edit is proposable there (win[0..5] already hold the target strings and an edit would fail the exact-before check). Row 6 moved the full layer to Karma to match win[6]; phases[6].why already describes Karma's late-game utility, so it needed no rewrite. Ratings left untouched — could not determine whether phases[N].rating is owner-favourability or matchup severity. Only one report[] entry rewritten (report[5].t), inside the two-entry cap. Note: the kit file lists Comet Spear at 575 range, but Riot's text distinguishes a thrust from a throw and gives one number; I wrote the number as-is and made no claim about the thrown range.
